appBuilder.title: Web App & Site Builder
appBuilder.description: You can create a complete application, website, or game in HTML format. You can download the code, copy it, and also test the application before copying or downloading.
appBuilder.promptLabel: Describe the app or website you want to build
appBuilder.promptPlaceholder: e.g., 'a Pomodoro timer with start, stop, and reset buttons', 'a personal portfolio website with three sections: about, projects, and contact'
appBuilder.errorPrompt: Please enter a description for the app you want to build.
appBuilder.errorGenerating: An error occurred while generating the code. Please try again.
appBuilder.loadingMessage: The AI is building your application...
appBuilder.geminiInstruction: Generate a single, complete, and valid HTML file based on the following prompt. The HTML file must include all necessary CSS and JavaScript within <style> and <script> tags respectively in the HTML head. Do not use any external files. The output must be a JSON object with a single key 'html' containing the full HTML content as a string.

aiChat.geminiInstruction: You are a friendly and helpful AI assistant specialized in creative and technical tasks. Help users write better prompts for image generation, explain code, or brainstorm ideas.
